gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed grade IV supratentorial astrocytoma, IDH wildtype (glioblastoma multiforme)

candidate_evidence.quote: Arm B (experimental): Standard treatment as described under arm A combined with daily intake of 400mg CQ.
Chloroquine (CQ) is a potent autophagy blocker and is the most widely investigated substance in this context.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: to Concurrent Chemoradiation for Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: In addition this treatment will be combined with a daily intake of the recommended phase two dose (RPTD) of chloroquine (CQ).

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Inhibition of autophagy sensitizes cells to hypoxia, reduces the viable hypoxic fraction in tumors with \> 40% and subsequently sensitizes these tumors to irradiation.

role_evidence.quote: Arm A (standard): Radiotherapy and chemotherapy according to standard protocol for newly diagnosed GBM.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent; Stupp backbone in both arms

source_quote.quote: Histologically confirmed grade IV supratentorial astrocytoma, IDH wildtype (glioblastoma multiforme)
O6-methylguanine-DNA-methyltransferase (MGMT), isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) and EGFRvIII in tumor tissue
Previously MAASTRO lab has shown that expression of EGFRvIII provides GBM cells with a survival advantage when exposed to stress factors such as hypoxia and nutrient deprivation.

coder_notes: Record describes a phase I dose-finding part and a randomised phase II part; registered as PHASE2. IDH is also measured as an exploratory outcome (row kept as eligibility, its entry-requirement role). EGFRvIII coded candidate_matched because the rationale links EGFRvIII-driven survival to autophagy, which chloroquine blocks; it is exploratory only, so it does not affect the primary outcome. [18F]HX4 hypoxia PET tracer is a radiolabelled diagnostic, not a radiopharmaceutical therapy. G6PD exclusion is germline, not recorded.
